Interest-bearing debt: 52.5% of its market value; the screen allows under 33%.
Cash and short-term investments: 1.1% of its market value; the screen allows under 33%.

checks.detail: Receivables plus cash: 3.9% of its market value; the screen allows under 49%.
Common screens also want under 5% of income from interest or other things not allowed, and some ask that it be given away. Free data does not show this; the study can look for it.
